verification.purpose: Per-component port gates (files, no-style, verbatim CSS, prop parity, manifest)
verification.evidence: number-field: ok, 0 errors repo-wide (check-port: 46 components, 0 errors).

gaps: Phase 1 still-port: the odometer digit wheels, rolling affix characters, word-rise helper row, limit-note slide, value strain kick, icon shake, and scrub/shift glide render their static end states. The `.column`, `.glyph`, `.char`, `.wordSlot`, `.wordSizer`, `.messageSlot`, `.words` and `.word` elements are kept so Phase 2 wires motion without restructuring.

The hold-to-repeat speedup curve, clamp/strain/limit-note cadence, live-apply typing, and scrub resistance math are ported; only their motion outputs (bumpY/scrubX/shiftX springs, icon shake, duplicate effort gain on the kick) are static.
React `useRef` mutable boxes map to plain script variables synced through `$effect`; `useLayoutEffect` measure/animate cycles are dropped with the motion.
`aria-describedby`/`aria-invalid` caller values are accepted and merged ahead of the hint and limit-note ids; ARC builds `aria-describedby` from hint + limit ids only.
